t19: The friends have arrived, the snacks are ready, the music is on — and then that familiar silence: "So, what shall we play?" The same story every time. In this article we have collected 30+ games so you never have to ask that question again: party games, classic favorites, brain puzzles and reflex duels. Zero materials, one phone, and everyone gets it in the first round.

t97: 5 Tips for a Great Game Night
t99: Make the first game something light like Wheel Challenge, Most Likely or Tombala. Taboo, Who Is The Agent? and Fun Series can join the night later.
t100: Play it safe with Fun Series.
t101: If you can't decide which game to pick, Fun Series plays 7 different modes back to back. The indecision ends.
t103: Sprinkle a round of Nine Men's Morris or Reflex Duel between the party games — the change of pace keeps the energy high.
t104: Get everyone into the game in the first 10 minutes.
t105: The person waiting for their turn ends up staring at their phone and tuning out. Mini games let everyone play at the same time.
t106: If the group is big, form teams.
t107: Once you go past 6 people, team modes (Taboo, Silent Word, Fun Series) keep the pace up.

t111: Which games can you play at home with 4 people?
t112: The most fun modes with 4 people: True or False, Draw Chain, Silent Word (in teams of two), Who Am I? and Nine Men's Morris. HomeParty supports all of these modes from 2 players up.
t113: Are there party games that need no materials?
t114: Yes, none of the 30+ games in HomeParty need any materials. All you need is a phone. The app manages rules, time and score automatically.
t116: HomeParty works for 2 to 16 people. Most party games can be played in teams or solo; brain and mini games are fun even with two.
t117: What's the difference between party games and mini games?
t118: Party games are group experiences where the phone goes from hand to hand — like taboo, silent word or who is the agent. Mini games are digital versions of classics such as tombala, trivia and nine men's morris. Both are in the same app.
